title: Akil writes the next word before it is written (crossed-out word test)

tellings.quote: it out the second it's crossed out and you start even thinking about the next one he'd start writing the next one

plain: In New Jersey in 2023, a boy named Akil is said to have written down each next word of a test before it was shown to him, starting as soon as the last word was crossed out and someone began to think of the next one. A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about telepathy called The Telepathy Tapes, tells Michels she watched this happen during a test that also involved someone named Manisha. If it happened as she describes, Akil was picking up words straight from another person's mind.
